$description: Material 3 ColorScheme roles: the 48 parameters of Compose lightColorScheme and darkColorScheme (androidx main, 84b8f8e, 2026-08-17). A role names the semantic token it takes, as an alias, or says "derived": derived roles come from a Material Color Utilities SchemeContent (colour spec 2021, contrast 0) seeded with the theme's primary, so they share its hue and chroma, with the container roles at the Material 3 baseline tones. The shadcn secondary is a low-emphasis tinted fill, so it maps to secondaryContainer and the M3 secondary is derived. shadcn accent is a hover and selection surface with no M3 peer, so the whole tertiary family is derived. onSurfaceVariant is derived to match the derived surface containers it sits on. outline has no semantic peer (--border is decorative and under 3:1), so it is derived too.
